mechanism.service: Sell BTC option convexity/insurance to participants who value crash protection or convex exposure.
mechanism.risk: Short-volatility tail risk, jump risk, inventory/hedge basis risk and adverse execution during stress.
mechanism.persistence_friction: Tail-risk aversion, capital/margin constraints and risk-bearing capacity prevent complete elimination of the premium.
mechanism.bilateral_rationale: Option buyers rationally pay for convex protection or mandated hedging; sellers accept tail risk in exchange for premium.
mechanism.competition_barrier: Professional market makers compete aggressively, but risk-capital limits and crash exposure mean the premium need not be arbitraged to zero.

accessibility.capture_path: Unauthenticated Deribit public BBO/order-book API for source building; any later execution would use venue-valid 0.1 BTC option size plus BTC perpetual hedge.
accessibility.data_access: Public current Deribit API; no paid historical source required for prospective build.
accessibility.execution_access: Public venue mechanics are compatible with the frozen 0.1 option-contract size; live account/margin eligibility remains a separate pre-live gate.
accessibility.capacity_constraint: Study is defined on 0.1 BTC option contracts and 1 BTC return denominator; capacity and margin are not inferred from historical PnL.
accessibility.hurdle_rationale: Economic hurdle equals a 10% annual compounded return requirement converted to seven days. Tail-risk gates remain separate and mandatory.
accessibility.cost_model: Measured executable option BBO entry/exit, Deribit BTC option fees, measured BTC-PERPETUAL BBO hedge entry/exit, perpetual fees/funding, plus the frozen adverse-tick/slippage stress.
accessibility.cost_uncertainty: Performance is not authorized until measured forward BBO exists. Official fee schedule is checked separately; no midpoint or modeled spread substitution.

source_gate.enumerability_rule: One non-overlapping weekly cohort at the frozen Thursday 08:00 UTC anchor; all source-valid cohorts count and no outcome-based exclusions are allowed.
source_gate.timestamp_rule: Entry and exit BBO must be contemporaneous public Deribit snapshots with source timestamps and no future information; stale/missing required BBO makes the cohort source-incomplete.
source_gate.treatment_binding: At entry, choose same-expiry same-strike BTC call+put with 25-35 DTE, target 30 DTE and minimum absolute log-moneyness using only point-in-time index/chain data; hold exactly seven days with static initial BTC perpetual delta hedge.

power_gate.nuisance_source: Legacy trade-print execution artifact run 35069743562 is used ONLY for nuisance dispersion planning: n=19, stress-return sample sd=0.0022938068056527205. Dispersion is conservatively inflated 25% to sigma=0.0028672585070659006; legacy mean is not used for confirmation.
power_gate.dependence_unit: Non-overlapping weekly 7-day cohort; final inference preserves four-observation block bootstrap and may blindly reduce effective N for missingness/dependence.

multiplicity.policy: One primary positive superiority claim on stress net mean above H. No regime, strike, cadence, hold-period, direction or cost rescue. Legacy discovery and prior execution MVEs remain separate trials.

freeze.outcome_boundary: No forward strategy return, PnL, expectancy, realized post-entry outcome or performance statistic may be computed/opened until the V2 collection target is met and a separate activation receipt confirms blind power/source integrity.
